user.title: Add Bose device
user.description: Choose how the Bose device should be added and whether you want a quick or expert setup.

discover.title: Discover Bose device
discover.description: Choose one of the discovered Bose devices. You can adjust the displayed device name before continuing.

manual.title: Add Bose device manually
manual.description: Enter only the basic Bose device details first. Routing and presets are configured in the next steps.

routing.title: Choose routing
routing.description: Decide whether only the Bose player should be created, whether presets should play directly on the Bose via UPNP, or whether they should be routed to another player.

routing_player.title: Choose target player
routing_player.description: Select the Music Assistant or Home Assistant media player that Bose presets should be routed to.

presets.title: Presets 1–3
presets.description: Enter stream URLs for preset buttons 1–3. Leave empty to use the global default URL.

advanced.title: Advanced options
